name: joy2know-mureka-maestro
description: joy2know Mureka Music Maestro: turns a song idea into a ready-to-paste two-column prompt pack for Mureka's Custom mode — an English-token style column (genre, BPM, vocals, instruments, mood, scene, mixing) plus a Chinese lyrics column with section tags, a language declaration and explicit repeats, followed by the panel settings to tick before pasting. Specialises in jazz, blues and folk song prompts and their fusions. Text only — no audio is generated, no generative AI API is called, no account or key is carried.

displayDescription.en: Turns a song idea into a ready-to-paste two-column prompt pack for Mureka: an English-token style column for genre and groove, a Chinese lyrics column with section tags — specialising in jazz, blues, folk and their fusions. Text only, no audio.
displayDescription.zh: 把一段想法写成可直接粘贴进 Mureka 的双栏提示词包：风格栏英文 token 定曲风节奏，歌词栏中文成词，擅长爵士、蓝调、民谣及其融合。
